name: tag-per-track
description: Agentic-first audio analysis, AI music detection and music tagging with x402 USDC micro-payments on Base.

private_key.title: Base Burner Wallet Private Key
private_key.description: 66-character hex private key starting with 0x (burner wallet funded with USDC on Base network)

max_spending_usdc.title: Max Spending Cap (USDC)
max_spending_usdc.description: Client-side safety limit in USDC per request (default: 0.50)

tools.name: analyze_audio
tools.description: Analyzes a music track or audio file to extract musical metadata (BPM, genre, mood, key, instruments), AI music detection verdict (HUMAN vs AI_GENERATED Suno/Udio neural vocoder risk with confidence index in 'ai_detection'), and optionally vocal lyrics. Supports local audio files via 'filePath' (read in binary and uploaded) or remote URLs via 'fileUrl'. Note: This tool automatically executes a micro-payment (0.15 USDC for standard analysis, or 0.25 USDC when extractLyrics is enabled) via the x402 protocol on Base.

filePath.description: Path to a local audio file on disk (.mp3, .wav, .ogg, .flac, .m4a, .aac, .aiff). Use this whenever analyzing a local file, recording, or email attachment saved locally.

fileUrl.description: The direct publicly accessible URL (HTTP/HTTPS or IPFS) of the audio file to analyze.

extractLyrics.description: Optional: Set to true to transcribe and extract vocal lyrics in addition to metadata. Costs 0.25 USDC instead of 0.15 USDC.

tools.name: analyze_audio_with_lyrics
tools.description: Analyzes an audio track to extract complete musical metadata, AI-generated music detection verdict (HUMAN vs AI_GENERATED Suno/Udio), AND transcribe full vocal lyrics using AI. Supports local audio files via 'filePath' (read in binary and uploaded) or remote URLs via 'fileUrl'. Note: This tool automatically executes a micro-payment of 0.25 USDC via the x402 protocol on Base. (Alias for analyze_audio with extractLyrics: true).

filePath.description: Path to a local audio file on disk (.mp3, .wav, .ogg, .flac, .m4a, .aac, .aiff). Use this whenever analyzing a local file, recording, or email attachment saved locally.

fileUrl.description: The direct publicly accessible URL (HTTP/HTTPS or IPFS) of the audio file to analyze.

tools.name: analyze_audio_batch
tools.description: Analyzes multiple music tracks or audio files in parallel (batch processing). Vastly reduces total execution time compared to sequential processing. Accepts a list of local file paths ('filePaths') or remote URLs ('fileUrls'), or a structured array of 'tracks'. Executes micro-payments per track on Base via x402.

tracks.description: Array of audio items to analyze in parallel. Each item can specify 'filePath' or 'fileUrl' and optional per-track 'extractLyrics'.

filePath.description: Path to a local audio file on disk.

fileUrl.description: Direct public URL of the audio file.

extractLyrics.description: Whether to extract vocal lyrics for this specific track (costs 0.25 USDC instead of 0.15 USDC).

filePaths.description: Convenience shortcut: list of local audio file paths to analyze in parallel.

fileUrls.description: Convenience shortcut: list of remote audio URLs to analyze in parallel.

extractLyrics.description: Optional global flag: set to true to transcribe and extract vocal lyrics for all tracks in this batch (0.25 USDC per track). Default is false (0.15 USDC per track).

concurrency.description: Maximum number of simultaneous parallel requests (1 to 5, default is 4 to respect API rate limits).

tools.name: lookup_artist_stats
tools.description: Retrieves streaming traction and commercial metrics for an artist (Spotify monthly listeners, followers, popularity score) for A&R qualification.

artist_name.description: Stage name of the artist to look up.

social_links.description: Optional social media profile links for future enrichment.

prompts.name: qualify_demo_ar
prompts.description: Comprehensive A&R demo evaluation for record labels and music curators. Combines Essentia acoustic analysis (BPM, key, scale, moods, genres, instruments, lyrics) with real-time Spotify streaming traction (monthly listeners, popularity) to produce an A&R Executive Memo with an Emerging Gem verdict.

arguments.name: audio_source
arguments.description: Path to a local audio file on disk (.mp3, .wav, .flac, .m4a, .aiff) or remote public URL of the track

arguments.name: artist_name
arguments.description: Artist or band stage name to cross-reference public streaming traction on Spotify (monthly listeners, followers, popularity score)

arguments.name: extract_lyrics
arguments.description: Set to 'true' to transcribe full vocal lyrics using AI Whisper and evaluate lyrical themes (costs 0.25 USDC instead of 0.15 USDC)

prompts.name: batch_demo_screening
prompts.description: Screens an EP, album, or folder of demo submissions in parallel using analyze_audio_batch. Evaluates energy flow, harmonic key progression, and selects standout lead singles.

arguments.name: audio_sources
arguments.description: Comma-separated list or JSON array of local audio file paths or remote URLs to analyze in parallel
